reasoning: The icon clearly depicts an airplane taking off from a runway, universally understood as flight departure or air travel. It is ideal for tasks involving booking flights, checking in, going to the airport, or managing outbound trips, though it should be distinguished from flight arrivals (landing icon) or general luggage/passport tasks.
